The '''S-class light star cruiser''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during or before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The ship had atleast one model that was regarded as old by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the time leading up to the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|Battle of Sebaddon]].

A ship of this design was possibly taken and modified by [[Fastbreeder|hex]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
Footage of the destroyed ship ''[[Cinzia]]'' showed signs of the vessel being a heavily modified craft, with a refurbished hull over an Imperial-made chassis, possibly a S-class one. It had a crew quarter capacity of barely a dozen people. Imperial [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence]] agent [[Ula Vii]] speculated upon seeing the footage that the ship had been stripped down and rebuilt from the inside-out. The ship's drive units were also similar to the S-class's, but their emissions were baffled.
